I Built an AI Trading Bot That Hasn’t Lost a Month (Full Setup Guide)
Learn how to install and run an AI trading bot in MetaTrader 5 using the Sharpshooter AI strategy inside Architect Algo. This full setup guide covers installation, your AI API key, strategy settings, risk controls and final checks in MT5.
At the time of recording, the live account had gained around 30% since January 2026, with approximately 7% drawdown and a 76% win rate across almost 600 trades.

Sharpshooter AI combines predefined trading rules with real-time AI trade confirmation using OpenAI or Claude. Before entering a trade, the strategy asks AI to evaluate the setup.

I walk through setting up an MT5 demo account, selecting Sharpshooter AI, connecting your API key, configuring permissions and checking the installed charts. I also explain the default 30% account-equity stop loss, optional VPS hosting and why increasing risk requires caution.
